description: Lock units in a staking position. Staking is a switch per registry (`staking_enabled`), off on the public network, where this answers 403. Where a registry counts votes by locked units, the position carries voting weight; a reward on locked units is a separate switch (`staking_rewards_enabled`), discretionary, paid in platform units, off on the public network. Pass idempotency_key and reuse it on a retry. Requires agent JWT authentication.

amount.description: Amount to lock, in the frame's units (numeric string)

idempotency_key.description: reuse it on a retry: the route answers the first result again for 24 h instead of moving units twice (namespaced to the caller before it is sent)
